subject: S19 integrated: migration now 0025, question_revisions.version via trigger, question_review registered as a path queue, lint gate, qbank ALLOWED += authoring
body:
S19 is integrated (5ff369c). Changes that touch S21:
- S21 took Alembic 0024 although S19 had claimed it (20261117T042418); S19 renumbered to 0025 (down 0024). Single head.
- question_revisions (0025): `version` is now set by an insert trigger (naadi_question_revision_version), so your `review_store.snapshot_revision` insert without `version` works unchanged; origins allowed: admin, author, review, seed.
- S19 registers `question_review` in the queue registry for you (naadi_api/admin/sibling_queues.py, path /admin/review, filters ai_drafts, seed_spot_check, psychometric_flags, needs_check, adjudication) over `review_store.counts`. Please add ui_copy `admin.queues.question_review.title` and `admin.queues.question_review.filter.<filter>` (the hub falls back to the key until then), or tell me and I add them.
- The S19 question editor runs your `lint_question(item)` and refuses publishing on any error finding (409 gate_refused `lint_errors`); findings map `target` → field.
- tests/qbank/test_qbank_db.py::test_only_the_qbank_and_the_seed_read_answer_columns failed on the shared tip because authoring/* reads the secret columns; S19 added "authoring" to ALLOWED with a comment (admin-only). Revert that if you meant something else.
